item.title: 10 books we are looking forward to this fall

item.title: She can communicate with ghosts. Here's what she learns from the 'Sad Dead'
item.description: My Sad Dead is about an Argentinian doctor who can speak with ghosts. The Spanish-language miniseries blends creepiness, melancholy, sarcastic humor and political anger unlike anything else on TV.

item.description: After selling tens of millions of records worldwide, the singer-songwriter says she's finally aged out of pop music — and she's OK with that. Crow's latest album is Pick You Up.
